title.narrative: Procurement of Services - Technical Assistance for KESSP (Kenya Education Sector Support Programme)

description.narrative: This activity Procurement of Services - Technical Assistance for KESSP (Kenya Education Sector Support Programme) is a component of kenya education sector support programme (kessp) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £2,127,974. It works in the following sector(s): Education policy and administrative management, Education facilities and training, Basic life skills for adults, Primary education.
